create_quantlinear_4bit: create a QuantLinear module with 4-bit quantization for Intel XPU or CPU inference
build_quantlinear_from_linear: build a QuantLinear module from an existing nn.Linear layer using the from_linear class method
run_quantlinear_forward: run the forward pass of a QuantLinear module on input tensor x using IPEX quantized kernels
review_quantlinear_post_init: review the post_init method that initializes the IPEX weight-only quantized linear layer from quantized weights
summarize_quantlinear_buffers: summarize the QuantLinear registered buffers including qweight, qzeros, scales, and bias tensors
